dedupe_keys.name: global energy transition tracker zone profiles

description: Global Energy Monitor’s Global Energy Transition Tracker publishes referenced energy-transition profiles for selected zones worldwide. The inspected hub describes 21 zones across about sixty countries or areas, with maps, dashboards and GEM.wiki fact sheets. Profiles connect operating and prospective solar, wind and fossil-fuel assets with policy targets, transmission, land availability, ownership and finance. Plant fields include name, location, capacity, technology, status and start year. Updates occur twice yearly, with July 2026 identified on the provider page. Public data are free under GEM’s default CC BY 4.0 policy unless separately noted; the inspected access routes are web maps, dashboards and referenced profiles, and no bulk export was verified. A limitation is that NGOs help select these zones for campaign relevance, so coverage is purposive, not a representative global sample. Simulation uses include assembling regional transition scenarios and identifying institutional constraints. It complements data-gem-global-integrated-power-tracker with contextual zone information. No matching catalogue or first-review draft was found. Profiles describe current and proposed infrastructure; they do not establish that planned transitions have been completed.
